_comment: Corrections to a food bank's own pin when Give Food lists a postal address instead of where food is given out. Checked on the food bank's own site. Applied by scripts/classify.py on every build. Stale pins listed in _remove_ids are dropped.

littlehampton-district.address: Rear hall, Littlehampton United Church, 1 High Street, Littlehampton, BN17 5EG
littlehampton-district.evidence: Food bank's own site: 'FOODBANK CENTRE ADDRESS: Rear hall, Littlehampton United Church, BN17 5EG' (Tue, Thu); 'POSTAL ADDRESS: Littlehampton Baptist Church, BN17 5NY'. Dean (local) confirms it is not an admin office, 21 Oct 2026.

west-ardsley.address: West Ardsley Community Centre, Batley Road, West Ardsley, Wakefield, WF3 1HD (temporary pantry venue)
west-ardsley.evidence: Temporary Friday pantry venue per westardsleychurch.org.uk/calendar.html and the Ofsted record for the Batley Road centre; pin = postcodes.io centroid for WF3 1HD (Dean 24 Oct)

invergordon.evidence: Food bank's own Facebook page (About section, checked 24 Oct 2026): 9 Joss Street, IV18 0AP, phone 07803 259452; replaces 138-140 High Street, IV18 0AE; pin = postcodes.io centroid for IV18 0AP (Dean 24 Oct)
